mercimek.name: Isuphu yeLentile
mercimek.description: Isuphu yasekhaya ye-lentile elungiselelwe ngendlela yesintu, igqitywe ngesosi yeBhotolo.

tas-kebabi.name: Isityu seNyama yeBhere yaseTurkey
tas-kebabi.description: Inyama yephezolo, imifuno yesizini, kunye nesosi ekhethekileyo epholileyo yase-restorenti yethu.

kuzu-tandir.name: Imvubu eRhotshiwe kancinci
kuzu-tandir.description: Imvubu ebonakalayo yase-restorenti yethu ye-tandoori, iphekwa kancinci ngaphezu kobushushu obuphantsi.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Ipilaf yeRayi
pirinc-pilavi.description: Ipilaf yeRayi eneBhotolo, epholileyo nefuphume kancinci.

firin-sutlac.name: Ipudding yeRayi eBhakiweyo
firin-sutlac.description: Ipudding yerayisi ebhakwe ngendlela yesintu, ilungiselelwe nobisi lwemvu lwemihla ngemihla.

kuru-fasulye.name: Isuphu yeBhinzi emhlophe neNyama yenkabi
kuru-fasulye.description: Iibhonzi ze-İspir, inyama yenkabi eqingqiweyo, kunye nephepha leetumato elilula lesitayile seshishini lokutyela.

izgara-kofte.name: Inyama ezitya ezigrileyiweyo
izgara-kofte.description: Amazambane enyama yenkabi esitayile sobugcisa besidlo kunye nephepha elibhemileyo kunye neetumato.

ayran.name: Ayran eChurniweyo
ayran.description: Ubisi oluqhelekileyo oluchurniweyo olunemfo emininzi, lwenziwe ngeyogathi yosuku nosuku.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Isuphu ye-Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Isuphu yesitayile seshishini lokutyela apho iilentshi ezibomvu, ibulgur, kunye nerayisi kudibana neminti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Isuphu ye-Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: ITarhana yasekhaya, iklasi yakwa-Anatolia ephekiwe kancinci kunye neetumato kunye neminti eyomileyo.

yayla-corbasi.name: Isuphu yobisi olubisiweyo kunye nerayisi
yayla-corbasi.description: Isuphu esihlaziyayo nesinobisi esilungiselelwe ngobisi, irayisi, kunye neminti eyomileyo.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeTripe
iskembe-corbasi.description: Isuphu efanelekileyo ye-tripe yenkomo isetyenziswa kunye nezithako zayo kunye neviniga ye-garlic.

dugun-corbasi.name: Isuphu YoMnyango
dugun-corbasi.description: Isuphu yesiqhelo yomtshato esenziwe ngemvu egayiwe kwaye ifakwe incasa ye-lemon marinade.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeChicken Broth
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Isuphu esonyibilikayo esilungiselelwe ngamanqina amancinci abiliswe kwi-bone broth kunye nenyama yekukhiye egayiwe.

domates-corbasi.name: Isuphu yetumato
domates-corbasi.description: Ukunambitha ocekeceke ukupheka kunye notumato oluhlumeleyo, ibhotela, kunye ne-basil, kugqitywa neshizi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeMifuno
sebze-corbasi.description: Isuphu ekhanyayo yesitayile sase-restoranti elungiselelwe ngemifuno yesizini, ioli ye-olivo, kunye neemifuno ezitsha.

beyran-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeLamb Beyran enePepper
beyran-corbasi.description: Isuphu yesithili elungiselelwe ngaphezulu kobushushu obuphezulu kunye ne-lamb, irayisi, igalikhi, kunye nepepper eshushu.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeNtloko neZinyawo
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Isuphu egcwele umhluzi wemathambo yenziwe ngeenyawo zenkukhu kunye nenyama yentloko ephekiweyo iiyure ezininzi.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Isuphu yeVermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Isuphu yemihla ngemihla elungiswe ngebroth yenkuku eneitumato, ivemicelli, kunye neparsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Izinti Zenkuku
tavuk-sis.description: Izingceba zenkuku ezimakishwa ngezixholo ezikhethekileyo, zisetyenziselwa kunye neepere ezivuthayo neeitumato.

kasap-sucuk.name: ISucuk yoMthengisi eGrilwe
kasap-sucuk.description: Isosi yenkomo enencasa ephakathi ifakwe ecaleni komlilo, kunye nemifuno evuthayo kunye anyanisi onesumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Gril EliHlanganisiweyo
karisik-izgara.description: Ipheyile enkulu kwaye yokudibanisa igrill equlethe ibifteki, izinti zenkuku, iziqholo zompheki, kunye nesosi.

nohut-yemegi.name: Istoo seChickpea kunye neNkomo
nohut-yemegi.description: Isidlo sasekhaya sefunde kunye nenyama yenkomo egayiweyo iphekwa kancinci epotini yentsimbi yerhasi.

patlican-musakka.name: I-Eggplant Moussaka
patlican-musakka.description: I-eggplant ephosiweyo, inyama yenkomo egayiweyo, kunye ne-moussaka iphekwe kwi-oveni kunye nesosi yetumato, ngendlela yesityebi esitshayelwa yindawo yokutyela.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: I-Green Beans kwi-Olive Oil
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Eyomveli iphekiwe kwi-olive oil kunye neebhontshisi eziluhlaza, iitamatato, kunye ne-anyanisi, inikezelwe ipholile.

tavuk-sote.name: Inkukhu eSautéed
tavuk-sote.description: Iziqephu zenkukhu ziyasautèed phezu kobushushu obuphezulu kunye neepaprika ezinemibala, iimushrooms, kunye neetamatato.

izmir-kofte.name: Amaqhambazi e-İzmir-Style
izmir-kofte.description: Isidlo sesiqhelo esikhulu esenziwe nenyama yenkomo, amathanga, neephepha ezibhakiweyo kwisosi yetumato.

etli-bezelye.name: Imbewu yePeas kunye neNyama yEnkomo
etli-bezelye.description: Isidlo semihla ngemihla esibilisiweyo epotini nenyama yenkomo eqhotsiweyo, imbewu yepeasi, iikaroti, namathanga.

patlican-oturtma.name: I-Eggplant ebhakwe nenyama egayiweyo
patlican-oturtma.description: Ulwimi lulungiselelwe ehoveni ne-eggplant, inyama eshushu egayiweyo, kunye nesosi yetumato negalikhi.

salgam-suyu.name: Ijusi yeTurnip eFermented
salgam-suyu.description: Ijusi yesiqhelo ye-turnip eshushu efakwe i-fermented kwi-karoti ephuphuma kunye nobhiya be-bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Amanzi eMinerali
maden-suyu.description: Amanzi eminerali esiqhelo, eplaini anikezelwe ebanda.

su.name: Amanzi anemithombo yendalo
su.description: Amanzi emithombo yendalo aphakelwa epholile kwiibhotile zeglasi.

kola.name: ICola
kola.description: Isiselo esiqhelekileyo esinecarbonated esiphakelwa sishushu kakhulu.

gazoz.name: Isoda yeLemoni yaseTurkey
gazoz.description: Isoda esiqhelekileyo enevumba elintle, epholileyo kwaye ingenamtya.

turk-kahvesi.name: Ikaffee yesiTurkey
turk-kahvesi.description: Ikaffee yesiTurkey yesintu eneqhukula, iphekwe kumlilo ophezulu kwisitya sesilivere.

demleme-cay.name: Iti yesiTurkey epholileyo
demleme-cay.description: Iti eshushu yeRize epholileyo kwisitya esincinane esinemiphetho emxinwa.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Ilamani ekhaya
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemonade epholileyo ilungiselelwa mihla le ngomlomo omtsha, iminti, kunye nomgubo omncinci.

hosaf.name: Isiqhamo seKomphote Ngemihla
hosaf.description: Ikhompote yasekhaya ibhakedwa mihla le kunye neerayisi, ii-aprikoti, okanye ii-plamu ngokwe ixesha lesizini.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Inyama ijikeleziswa kwisikhonkwane phezu kwepide, inikezelwa nesosi yetamato, ibhotolo eshushu, kunye nobisi olunencindi.

kazandibi.name: Pudingi yobisi oluneKhemikhali
kazandibi.description: Idesethi yobisi yesiqhelo iphambili ngokuchanekileyo, ngobumba obuthambileyo.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Pudingi yobisi ye-Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Isidlo esimnandi esilula nesinothayo esenziwe ngobugcisa bendabuko, sinikwa nesinamoni.

keskul.name: Ipudding yobisi lwe-Almond
keskul.description: Isidlo sobisi ngendlela yakwa-Ottoman esigqityiweyo ngesiphumo se-almond kunye nekhokhonathi.

irmik-helvasi.name: I-Semolina Halva
irmik-helvasi.description: I-semolina halva, itshisiwe ngebhotela kunye neentlobo zomthi wepinen, inikwa ishushu kwaye inesayizi yembewu.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Isidlo soMququ wePumpkin kunye neTahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Ipumpkin, iphekwa kancinci kumthamo walo, inikwa kunye ne-tahini kunye neengqolowa.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Isidlo seQuince
ayva-tatlisi.description: I-Quince iphekiwe kunye ne-clove kunye nesinamoni inikwa kunye ne-cream eqinileyo kunye neengqolowa.

revani.name: Ikhekhe yeSemolina eneSiraphu
revani.description: Ideserta yesiqhelo yezindawo zokutyela apho ikhekhe elithambileyo lesemolina lihlangana nesiraphu enuka ilamuni.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Ipudingi yesonka eneCream eqinileyo
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Ipudingi yesonka elivela kwisiraphu eshukumayo lisetyenziswa kunye ne-cream eqinileyo yebhufu.

cevizli-baklava.name: Walnut Baklava
cevizli-baklava.description: Iileya ezityiweyo kakhulu, i-baklava eswiti eyenziwe ngama-walnut amaninzi kunye nebhotolo eqhelekileyo.
